findings.quote: Results were convincing although rather anticlimactic as none of the silicone samples burned.
findings.about: No Saffire-II silicone sample burned in orbit
findings.note: Silicone 0.27, 0.61, 1.03 mm (concurrent) and 0.37 mm (opposed), 20 cm/s, about 22.1% O2.

findings.quote: ‒ The 0.61-mm thickness burned on average 7.6 cm of the available 30 cm before extinguishing
findings.about: Silicone 0.61 mm, upward at 1 g: average burn length
findings.note: NASA's normal-gravity upward-burning tests; the 1 g sample length is given here as 30 cm.

findings.quote: Flammability of silicone in microgravity appears to be reduced compared to normal gravity, at least for the flow speeds tested.
findings.about: Silicone is less flammable in microgravity than at 1 g, at the flow speeds tested

findings.quote: Initial oxygen concentration 22.1% (ISS reading, slightly higher than Saffire-1’s 21.7%)
findings.about: Saffire-II starting oxygen, as read on the ISS

findings.quote: All upward burns except Sample 2-4 was downward
findings.about: Saffire-II: all burns upward (concurrent) except 2-4, downward (opposed)
